**Implementation note:** Exponentially weighted anomaly bands; not used to filter trades.

## Description

Detect unusual price, spread, volume or order-flow observations using statistical or unsupervised models, then filter trades or flag risk.

## Where it may fit

Monitoring for liquidity shocks, unusual events or behavior outside normal calibration.

## Vehicles

Any liquid-market strategy; risk-control, execution and surveillance systems.

## Required data

Trades/quotes, OHLCV, rolling baselines, spread/volume features, timestamps and data-quality flags.

## Caveats

An anomaly is not necessarily predictive; can be caused by bad ticks, corporate actions or scheduled events.
